people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Jazer
people.line: A town in Gilead, allotted to Gad

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
translations.bsb: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, Israel captured its villages and drove out the Amorites who were there.
translations.kjv: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites
translations.asv: And Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they took the towns thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
